summary: Sum the step property of K over the pairs (p, q).

steps.claim: Take the step property of K at frequency 0 and in general; summing it over the finitely many pairs (p, q): a finite sum of integrable functions is integrable, the integral of the sum is the sum of the integrals J_i(a_p, a_q), and |∑_{p,q} ∫ψ(ξc)J_{i+1}(…)| ≤ ∑_{p,q} β(ξ)Λ_i(a_p)Λ_i(a_q) = β(ξ)(∑_p Λ_i(a_p))².
